facts.claim: Delta plans 258 daily international departures in Q3 2027, 6% more than Q3 2026, with 14 daily departures added.
15 new and returning international routes were identified versus Q3 2026, eight medium and long-haul and seven short-haul, from six hubs and focus cities.
Atlanta–Tel Aviv returns on December 19, 2026, three times weekly on the A350-900, suspended since 2023.
Austin–Paris Charles de Gaulle starts March 27, 2027, daily on the A330-900, a brand-new market and Delta's only long-haul route from Austin.
Los Angeles–Manila starts March 27, 2027, daily on the A350-900; Seattle–Tokyo Narita returns March 27, 2027, daily on the A330-900.
Boston–Reykjavík starts April 12, 2027, daily on the 757-200, previously served in 2021; Boston–Venice starts May 7, 2027, four times weekly on the A330-300.
8,455 movements are scheduled on the 757-200 and 757-300 in Q3 2027, down 60% from Q3 2026, while international 757 flights are up 30%.

zh.title: 達美航空2027年第三季新增15條國際航線 亞特蘭大—利雅德等8條中長程線領軍
zh.summary: 根據Cirium Diio數據，達美航空2027年第三季每日國際出發航班預計達258班，較2026年同期成長6%；與2026年第三季相比，達美將新增或恢復15條國際航線，其中8條為中長程航線、7條為短程航線。
body: 達美航空正為2027年夏季擴大國際網絡。根據Cirium Diio數據，2027年第三季（7至9月）達美每日國際出發航班預計達258班，較2026年同期增加14班、成長6%，是該季度歷來第七高的運量；不過班表仍可能隨計畫確定而調整。這15條新增或恢復的航線來自六個樞紐與重點城市，其中8條為中長程航線、7條為短程航線，且皆已公布並排入班表。

8條中長程航線包括亞特蘭大—利雅德（2027年3月27日開航，全新市場）、亞特蘭大—特拉維夫（2026年12月19日復航，每週3班A350-900，2023年起因戰爭停飛）、奧斯汀—巴黎戴高樂（2027年3月27日開航，每日1班A330-900，全新市場，也是達美自奧斯汀出發的唯一長程航線）、波士頓—雷克雅維克（2027年4月12日開航，每日1班757-200，2021年後首度恢復）、波士頓—威尼斯（2027年5月7日開航，每週4班A330-300，全新市場）、底特律—雅典（2027年6月8日開航，每週3班A330-200，全新市場）、洛杉磯—馬尼拉（2027年3月27日開航，每日1班A350-900）與西雅圖—東京成田（2027年3月27日復航，每日1班A330-900，2020年後首度恢復）。7條短程航線則包括奧斯汀—坎昆、奧斯汀—洛斯卡波斯、底特律—蒙特哥貝、洛杉磯—墨西哥城、洛杉磯—溫哥華、紐約拉瓜迪亞—百慕達與西雅圖—洛斯卡波斯，其中4條已於2026年10月至11月間恢復，其餘3條將於12月恢復。
機隊方面，757機隊的角色持續縮小：2027年第三季達美757-200與757-300合計排定8455班次，較2026年同期減少60%；不過國際線757航班反而增加30%。達美9月與10月已接收9架A321neo，機隊更新正加速。值得注意的是，本文統計僅納入已公布且已排班的航線，西雅圖即將公布的新航線與外界揣測的新加坡航線均未列入。

en.title: Delta to add 15 international routes in Q3 2027, led by eight medium and long-haul services
en.summary: Delta Air Lines plans 258 daily international departures in the third quarter of 2027, 6% more than a year earlier, with 15 new and returning international routes compared with Q3 2026 — eight medium and long-haul and seven short-haul — from six hubs and focus cities.
body: Delta Air Lines is expanding its international network for summer 2027. Based on Cirium Diio schedule data, the airline plans 258 daily international departures in the third quarter of 2027, 14 more per day and 6% higher than the same quarter in 2026, the seventh-highest volume on record for the period — though the schedule remains subject to change as plans are finalised. The 15 new and returning routes come from six hubs and focus cities, and all have already been announced and scheduled.

The eight medium and long-haul additions are Atlanta–Riyadh, starting March 27, 2027, a brand-new market; Atlanta–Tel Aviv, returning December 19, 2026, three times weekly on the A350-900 after suspension since 2023; Austin–Paris Charles de Gaulle, starting March 27, 2027, daily on the A330-900 and Delta's only long-haul route from Austin; Boston–Reykjavík Keflavík, starting April 12, 2027, daily on the 757-200 and last served in 2021; Boston–Venice, starting May 7, 2027, four times weekly on the A330-300; Detroit–Athens, starting June 8, 2027, three times weekly on the A330-200; Los Angeles–Manila, starting March 27, 2027, daily on the A350-900; and Seattle–Tokyo Narita, returning March 27, 2027, daily on the A330-900 after last operating in 2020. The seven short-haul additions are Austin–Cancun, Austin–Los Cabos, Detroit–Montego Bay, Los Angeles–Mexico City, Los Angeles–Vancouver, New York LaGuardia–Bermuda and Seattle–Los Cabos, four of which have already returned, with the remaining three due back in December.

The Boeing 757's role continues to shrink: Delta has 8,455 movements scheduled on the 757-200 and 757-300 in Q3 2027, down 60% from a year earlier, although international 757 flying is up 30%. Fleet renewal is accelerating, with nine A321neos delivered in September and October 2026 alone. The comparison covers only routes already disclosed and scheduled; a new Seattle route expected to be revealed on December 2 and speculated Singapore service are excluded.
